### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

A clear and concise description of what the feature or problem is.

### Proposed solution

How will it benefit this public edition and its users? State whether the change concerns the RetiMCP gateway, a custom `/dev` tool, documentation, or the included upstream implementation.

### Example prompts or workflows (for tools/toolsets only)

If it is a new tool or improvement, share a few example workflows using synthetic data. Explain any effect on authentication, execution limits, or the fixed worktree boundary. A request does not guarantee implementation.

### Additional context

Add relevant context or mockups. Do not include credentials, private source code, personal information, or deployment identifiers.
